title: Interests outside music, Garner, and going to the movies
summary: Stewart was wrapped up in music, liked cards, and Garner was similar; he went to movies until TV came.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Uh-huh. What were your interests outside of music? I mean ways that you, things that you did.

Well, I liked to -- like I just said, I liked to play cards, and I wasn't hardly a sportsman, what you might say. I wasn't interested in sports all that much. Oh, what did I do that was interesting. Well, I was so wrapped up in my music that, when I finished rehearsing and practicing and what have you, it was time to try to get some rest and, you know, get ready for the next day.
So you spent most of your time working on your music with your other musicians?
When you -- what about when you -- what about Erroll Garner. What were his, what were some of his interests that you recall?
Well, I think it was about the same as myself.
He was mostly wrapped up in his music?
He was mostly wrapped up in his music. Sure.
Uh-huh. Now, he was from Pittsburgh.
Did he ever talk to you about any musicians that he was impressed with from his home town?

Well, no, not really. Of course, he was from a musical family, and if I'm not mistaken, I think one of his brothers played piano also, and he was from a musical family and all -- I guess that was about it. Most of our interest was music, yeah. I don't think he was interested in sports at all.
Huh. What about movies. Did you guys go to movies much in those days?

Well, I went to movies once in a while, probably not as much as a lot of people do. But to the movies -- I went quite a bit, come to think of it, until later on when TV came out. Then -- I haven't been in a theater, I might
say, in the last 20 years to see a movie, really, actually to see a movie.
So you just -- you did go see a lot of films in those days?
Not too many, just enough to pass the time when I wasn't working on that bass fiddle, you know.
